cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(target_build C)
set(sources main.c)
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4)
  list(APPEND sources extra.c)
  set(lane_value 13)
else()
  set(lane_value 17)
endif()
add_executable(program ${sources})
add_library(parts STATIC ${sources})
foreach(output program parts)
  target_compile_definitions(${output} PRIVATE LANE_VALUE=${lane_value})
endforeach()
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4)
  target_link_libraries(program PRIVATE m)
endif()
